l3UsageSemantics.meaning: Body dimensions support a bounded space check; nominal 60 cm class is not an exact fit guarantee.
Declared place-setting capacity is comparable capacity evidence, not a household-size or loading-pattern guarantee.
Energy class and water values are comparable only under the same verified declaration regime and Eco cycle; Beko remains unknown for this comparison.
Declared airborne acoustic noise supports same-regime display, not perceived quietness in a particular home.
Auto-open and extra-dry are feature-presence evidence only and do not guarantee a drying result, including plastics.
A cutlery tray is a verified loading feature; usable layout and fit for particular items remain unproven.
Connectivity or water-protection feature state does not establish service availability or leak prevention outcome.
